task.question: At the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix, how many years had Esteban Ocon been in Formula 1 since his debut?
task.evidence: At this weekend’s Belgian Grand Prix, Esteban Ocon will celebrate 10 years since his F1 debut.
task.page: Esteban Ocon reflects on 10 years in F1

answer:
I need to find when Esteban Ocon made his Formula 1 debut and calculate how many years had passed by the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix.

Esteban Ocon made his Formula 1 debut at the 2016 Belgian Grand Prix (as a replacement driver for Manor Racing).

The 2026 Belgian Grand Prix would be in 2026.

2026 - 2016 = 10 years.

FINAL: 10
